claims.claim: PromptPack schema requires id, name, version, template_engine, prompts; optional $schema, description, fragments, tools, metadata, compilation, evals, workflow, agents, skills, compositions, requires
embedded PromptPack schema is version 1.9.0 (identical to promptpack-spec schema)
pack structure checks id, semver version, prompts, template_engine, system_template, prompt version, variables-declared are blocking; missing compilation and undeclared prompt tools are warnings
prompt requires id, name, version, system_template; id pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$; optional fields list; tool requires name, description
each prompt gets the default template/provider/validator pipeline

workflow requires version, entry, states; state fields on_event, persistence, orchestration internal|external|hybrid|composition, control user|agent, terminal, max_visits, on_max_visits, skills, artifacts, composition; terminal = terminal:true or no on_event
workflow errors/warnings: version 1|2, entry, prompt_task, targets, enums, composition, PascalCase, cycles, terminal, v2 dead-end, agent loops
compiled fragments map holds {{name}} placeholders, not fragment content
packc compile sets name=id, version from --pack-version (default v1.0.0), description 'Pack containing N prompts', $schema latest URL, compilation block
compile-prompt: id from task type (_ to -), name/description from prompt, version from spec.version or --pack-version, $schema set
pack id pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$; invalid --id rejected before compile with [pack_id] error
